description: Use when someone asks about the ritual of the 13 wishes for the Rauhnächte ("13 Wünsche Ritual", "Wunschzettel Rauhnächte", "wie geht das mit den dreizehn Wünschen", "Wünsche verbrennen"). Returns the ritual step by step: what to prepare before the first night, what to do in each of the twelve nights and what happens with the last wish, with the dates for the chosen way of counting (24 = first night 24/25 December, default; 25 = 25/26 December). German, informal "du". For reflection and entertainment only. Do not use for tarot, horoscopes, general astrology, other oracle decks, shopping or anything that is not about the Rauhnächte; then answer without this tool.

zaehlung.description: Zählweise: 24 = erste Nacht vom 24. auf den 25. Dezember (üblich, Standard), 25 = erste Nacht vom 25. auf den 26. Dezember.
